technical-summary: Wired the calibrating live policy through the manifest, off by default. The contract gains live_policy_state.requested=calibrating and a live_calibration block of declared objectives (effect windows, false-revert rate, and a heat-age limit derived from the heat period and the declared calibration_missed_heat_writes objective). The writer emits it only with --auto-calibrate-live-policy, a writable calibration store, a heat feed, a supported arrangement and no complete record; S10, the receipt and feature state accept the new state; the helper builds its calibrating settings from the block. The literal 2x heat period heat-age limit is removed and the smallest-valid minimums are documented.
user-summary-candidate: The live placement policy can now be calibrated in session from the manifest when explicitly requested; off by default.
